arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-10-02' AND date < '2019-11-01'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions in the 30-day window ending on the last day of the data, 31 October 2019.
assumptions: 'Last 30 days' is resolved against the last day of the data, 2019-10-31, not today. With that day counted as one of the 30, the window is 2019-10-02 through 2019-10-31 inclusive.
All transactions are counted, including those with no fraud label and those with negative amounts.
